narrative.northStar: Perkin Logistics — Maritime Freight Manifest & Port Control Ledger
narrative.overview: Built specifically for Perkin Logistics (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (perkin-logistics.com) using Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Combines Perkin's official brand palette—Perkin Maritime Navy (#071a2f / #0c2948), Perkin Royal Blue (#073766), Perkin Signal Orange (#f56a22), and Warm Manifest Cream (#f7f5ef)—with IBM Plex Sans Thai (looped Thai typography at 14.5px base size) and Manrope display headings for effortless, fatigue-free reading across 989+ shipment records.
keyCharacteristics: Perkin Logistics brand alignment: Deep Navy (#071a2f) command rail, skewed orange P emblem + official Perkin Logistics logo, and Signal Orange (#f56a22) primary actions
High-legibility looped Thai typography (IBM Plex Sans Thai at 14.5px base size) paired with Manrope headings and IBM Plex Mono tabular numbers
Component-driven Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS architecture with built-in REST API routes (/api/dashboard, /api/jobs/[jobNo], /api/uploads)
Architectural 1px hairline ledger grids (#dce1e5) on warm Perkin cream paper (#f7f5ef)

rules.name: The Looped Thai Legibility Rule
rules.body: All Thai operational copy, customer names, and form labels use IBM Plex Sans Thai (with loops) at 14px–15px with 1.55 line-height so staff can distinguish similar Thai characters effortlessly during long shifts.

rules.name: The Tabular Identifier Rule
rules.body: Every Job No, Transport No (TS26070003), Advance No (AV26070112), B/L number, date, day count, and currency value must use IBM Plex Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Perkin Brand Discipline Rule
rules.body: Perkin Signal Orange (#f56a22) is reserved for the brand emblem, primary CTAs, and active workflow highlights; Cleared Emerald (#0d7a5f), Royal Blue (#073766), and Alert Red (#d82936) signal operational state.

dos: Do keep IBM Plex Sans Thai at >=14px for body table cells and form controls.
Do keep IBM Plex Mono (tabular-nums) on all job identifiers, B/L codes, dates, row numbers, and financial figures.
Do surface data provenance and Excel sync state (OneDrive Excel Synced, source sheet, and row number) so operators trust that Web and Excel match 100%.
donts: Don't use tiny (<11px) loopless Thai fonts that cause eye strain in dense operational tables.
Don't add eyebrow/kicker text above headings in headers or drawers.
Don't use multi-pixel colored left borders (border-l-4) on cards or navigation items.
